title: Customer Success Operations Analyst
description:
Hansen Technologies (ASX: HSN) is a global software and services provider, serving energy, water/utilities, and telecommunications industries. With customers in 80\+ countries, we foster collaboration across 26 global offices. From 5G advancements to renewable energy transitions, we empower customers to overcome challenges, innovate, and drive new business models.
 



  





 At Hansen, we are also embedding AI enablement across our operations. From automating workflows and enhancing service delivery, to driving innovation in customer solutions, AI is shaping the next chapter of how we support our clients. With a focus on operational excellence and innovation, Hansen is using AI not just as a tool, but as a strategic enabler to deliver smarter, faster, and more resilient solutions for the future.
 



  





 This is a full\-time onsite
 **role based in our Pune office in India** 
 .
 



  





**Why This Role Matters** 




 The Customer Success Operations Analyst will run the analytical and operational engine behind Customer Success Operations for Hansen’s Energy and Utilities business. This role will create a clear, consistent view of customer health across regions, helping Customer Success Managers and commercial leaders identify risk early, track intervention and act well ahead of contractual notice windows.
 



  





**What You’ll Do** 



* Operate and maintain the customer health model, scoring every Energy and Utilities account against agreed inputs and cadence.
* Keep health scoring criteria up to date across key measures, such as customer sentiment, executive engagement and value realisation, ensuring clear ownership and historical tracking.
* Raise customer risk flags, route them to the relevant Customer Success Manager, regional leadership and track intervention progress through to remediation.
* Maintain visibility of contractual notice windows and renewal dates, ensuring accounts are reviewed well before key deadlines.
* Manage the renewal readiness process and develop account\-level revenue retention forecasts, monitoring accuracy over time.
* Run the customer sentiment programme, including NPS survey operations, response tracking and analysis by account, product and region.
* Produce customer success reporting packs covering health distribution, risk and intervention status, adoption, sentiment and monthly business review inputs.
* Partner with Revenue Operations, Finance and the Senior Revenue Analytics Manager to ensure gross and net revenue retention reporting is reconciled and consistent.
* Improve Dynamics 365 data quality and process adherence across lifecycle stages, health scores, Customer Success Plan records and activity capture.



  





**What You Bring** 



* Strong analytical and operational capability, with experience of turning customer, commercial or operational data into clear insight and action.
* Experience working with customer success, revenue operations, sales operations, renewals, account management or commercial reporting processes.
* Confidence building and operating customer health models, risk frameworks, dashboards or recurring business review reporting.
* Strong understanding of retention, renewal readiness, customer sentiment, adoption and revenue metrics, including gross and net revenue retention.
* Experience working with CRM data and processes, ideally within Dynamics 365, with the ability to improve data quality and adoption across teams.
* Highly organised and detail\-oriented, with the ability to manage regular reporting cycles, maintain documentation and support cross\-functional stakeholders.
* Comfortable working in a build environment where processes, measures and reporting are being established for the first time.



  





**Why Join Us?** 




 At Hansen, you’ll be part of a diverse, inclusive, and collaborative global team. Our culture is built around values such as People and Family, Treat It Like It’s Your Own, Focused and Committed, and One United Team. We look for people who are curious, respectful, engaged, and keen to work across geographies with talented teams.
 



  





 If you are passionate about customer success operations, data\-driven decision making and building scalable reporting foundations, we’d love to hear from you.
 



  





**Contact Us** 




 If you possess the desired skills and enthusiasm, please “Apply Now” via the link.
 



  





 We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status
 *.* 




  





 Visit our website at hansencx.com for more information.
 



  





  





**Data Privacy Notice** 




 By applying to this role, you consent to Hansen collecting, processing, and storing the information you provide for recruitment purposes. You also agree that your details may be securely retained in our talent database for future opportunities and reference in accordance with applicable data protection regulations.

title: Senior Technical Account Manager
description:
Hungry, Humble, Honest, with Heart.
   

  

 The Opportunity
   

  

 Are you a customer\-centric professional with a strong technical aptitude and exceptional communication skills, eager to take on the challenges of managing relationships with clients in a dynamic environment? If so, you would want to join our team as a Senior Technical Account Manager to play a crucial role in driving customer success and adoption of Nutanix products, while working in a collaborative, supportive culture alongside experienced professionals dedicated to innovation and excellence.
   

  

**About The Team**
 The Senior Technical Account Manager will be joining the APAC iTAM team at Nutanix, which is based in Pune. This team is dedicated to providing exceptional support and service to customers across the APAC region, fostering a strong customer\-centric culture characterized by collaboration, transparency, and mutual respect. The mission of the team is to drive customer success and maximize the value of Nutanix products, ensuring that clients realize their full potential and return on investment through proactive engagement and expert guidance.
   

  

 You will report to the Manager of Technical Account Management. The work setup for this role is primarily remote, with the expectation that all team members will be based in Pune to cater to the needs of customers across the region.
   

  

 For this role, travel is not a primary requirement; however, there may be occasional travel within India based on customer needs for face\-to\-face meetings. The position primarily involves remote service delivery to customers, maintaining the flexibility to accommodate varying customer preferences.
   

  

 Your Role
   

  

* Create a good understanding of the customer’s installed base in terms of licenses consumed/activated, asset refresh opportunities, capacity utilization, software versions, support tickets, features adopted etc.
* Drive increased product adoption, and experience by doing the following:
* Recommend use of features, use cases, and increased capacity utilization by providing insights on usage maturity, and recommending best practices
* Coordinate with Support and Engineering resources to ensure critical support issues are treated with appropriate urgency and visibility
* Identify training needs for the customer and help orchestrate training/boot camps for customers
* Identify the need to upgrade to the latest software versions and support the creation of an upgrade plan for the customer
* Recommend and/or perform health checks, as needed
* Pull in expert Nutanix resources for conducting deeper dives with the customer. Orchestrate the breadth of Nutanix resources (Delivery/Consulting, Support, Architects) as needed


 This role operates in a hybrid capacity, blending the benefits of remote work with the advantages of in\-person collaboration. For most roles, that will mean coming into an office a minimum of 2 \- 3 days per week, however certain roles and/or teams may require more frequent in\-office presence. Additional team\-specific guidance and norms will be provided by your manager.
   

  

 What You Will Bring
   

  

* 6\-10 years of work experience, preferably in technical customer\-facing roles (Support engineer, Systems engineer, Technical account manager)
* Strong knowledge of virtualization, cloud computing, and data center technologies (Nutanix Stack preferred)
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills with a customer\-centric attitude.
* High technical aptitude with understanding of infrastructure (storage, compute, network).
* Experience working in a customer\-facing role, with a focus on account management.
* Ability to collaborate effectively across multiple teams and manage customer relationships long\-term.
* Ability to drive a consultative conversation with the customer
* BE/B.Tech, advanced degree a plus


 Work Arrangement
   

  

 Hybrid: This role operates in a hybrid capacity, blending the benefits of remote work with the advantages of in\-person collaboration. In locations where our workplace policy applies (i.e. San Jose, Durham, Mexico City, Bangalore, Pune, Hoofddorp, Belgrade, Barcelona, Singapore, Sydney and Tokyo), employees are expected to work onsite a minimum of 3 days per week to foster collaboration, team alignment, and access to in\-office resources. Workplace type may vary based on location and team requirements. Please speak with your recruiter for details. Additional team\-specific guidance and norms will be provided by your manager.
   

  

 \-\-

title: Business 4.0
company: Škoda Auto Volkswagen India Private Limited
description:
**Position Name :** 
 Enterprise IT Business Relationship \& Delivery
   

  

**Department :** 
 IT
   

  

**Vacancy :** 
 1
   

  

**Qualification :** 
 Graduate / Post\-Graduate in Engineering, Technology, Management or equivalent
   

  

**Experience :** 
 10\+ Years
   

  

**Location :** 
 Pune
   

  

**Reporting to :** 
 Head \- Enterprise IT
   

  

**Purpose Of The Position**
 The Lead – Enterprise IT Business Relationship \& Delivery acts as the IT partner for assigned business functions and initiatives, from demand intake and solutioning through delivery, go\-live, stabilization and business value realization. The role works with business, internal IT, Group/local architecture teams and vendors to convert business priorities into practical technology initiatives and drives internal IT, Group teams and external vendors to ensure committed delivery outcomes and vendor obligations are met. After implementation and hyper care, the role ensures structured handover to the AMS team, owns IT assessment and governance of new change requests for assigned applications, and reviews support\-ticket trends with AMS to reduce repeat issues and improve service quality.
   

  

**Authority**
* Accept, return or challenge business demand based on completeness, ownership, expected outcome and readiness for IT assessment.
* Recommend prioritization of initiatives based on business value, risk, urgency, dependencies and available capacity.
* Require clear delivery plans, accountable owners and committed milestones from internal teams and external vendors.
* Escalate material delivery, architecture, vendor, cost, quality and service risks to the appropriate governance forum.
* Recommend go\-live hold where critical defects, architecture, security, support or operational\-readiness requirements are incomplete.
* Require corrective\-action plans for repeated vendor or service\-performance failures.
* Recommend Change Request disposition based on business value, delivery impact, architecture and commercial implications.
* Recommend vendor performance / commercial actions to Head – Enterprise IT and relevant governance.


**Skills Required**
* Business Relationship Management / Stakeholder Management
* End\-to\-End IT Delivery / Program Management
* Vendor Management \& Delivery
* Demand management and portfolio prioritization
* Business process analysis / digital transformation
* Business case / ROI / value realization
* Group / local architecture coordination and fit\-gap
* Enterprise applications – ERP, CRM, DMS and digital platforms
* Integration / API / data\-flow concepts
* Testing / UAT / cutover / stabilization governance
* ITSM – Incident, Problem, Change and Service Management
* Vendor commercial / contract awareness
* Cybersecurity / architecture / compliance awareness
* Executive communication, influencing and conflict management
* Internal Customer orientation / CSAT improvement


**Key Responsibilities \& Tasks**
**Business Partnership \& Demand Management**
* Act as primary IT relationship owner for assigned business functions and maintain a clear understanding of strategy, KPIs, priorities and pain points.
* Own structured demand intake and ensure each initiative has a named business owner, clear outcome, priority and value proposition.
* Translate business requirements into structured IT work packages and coordinate feasibility with relevant IT teams.
* Maintain a transparent demand backlog and 12–24 month business\-IT roadmap.


**End\-to\-End Delivery Accountability**
* Own overall IT delivery outcome from approved demand through implementation, go\-live and stabilization.
* Maintain integrated delivery plans covering scope, milestones, dependencies, risks, decisions and readiness.
* Coordinate business, internal IT teams, Group teams and external partners to ensure timely execution.
* Ensure critical dependencies, issues and decisions have clear owners and committed closure dates.
* Drive design, build, integration, testing, UAT readiness, cutover and stabilization governance.
* Ensure IT change management, implementation, security and governance controls are defined, validated and complied with for all assigned projects.
* Escalate risks early with clear business impact, options and decisions required.


**Vendor \& Group / Local Architecture Governance**
* Govern external vendors against agreed scope, milestones, quality, support commitments and contractual obligations.
* Drive vendor corrective actions for delays, defects, recurring issues or delivery gaps.
* Coordinate with Group and local architecture / application teams to ensure solution alignment and timely technical decisions.
* Ensure solution design, integration and platform choices conform to approved architecture, security and governance standards.
* Track vendor and Group dependencies through closure and recommend escalation or commercial action where required.


**Service, Support \& Sustenance Ownership**
* Ensure projects transition into a stable and sustainable support model with clear service/application ownership.
* Ensure L1/L2/L3 responsibilities, SLA/OLA, support contracts, monitoring, SOPs, knowledge transfer and lifecycle ownership are established.
* Review service performance, major incidents, recurring defects, backlog and vendor support performance for assigned applications.
* Drive Problem Management and continual improvement for recurring business\-impacting issues.
* Ensure post\-go\-live stabilization is completed before formal project closure.


**Business Readiness, Adoption \& CSAT**
* Ensure business readiness, UAT ownership, training/adoption needs and go\-live acceptance criteria are established.
* Measure project and service satisfaction and drive corrective actions for material gaps.
* Monitor solution adoption and identify barriers affecting business outcomes.
* Conduct structured post\-go\-live reviews with business and delivery stakeholders.


**Value Realization \& Portfolio Governance**
* Develop business cases jointly with business owners and define measurable expected benefits before investment.
* Establish baseline, target value, benefit owner and realization timeline for strategic initiatives.
* Track value realization after implementation and escalate gaps in adoption or benefit achievement.
* Support portfolio prioritization based on strategic fit, business value, risk and delivery capacity.


**Financial \& Commercial Governance**
* Support IT budget and investment planning for assigned business initiatives.
* Track project budget, committed spend, forecast and Change Request impact.
* Validate vendor estimates and commercial assumptions in coordination with IT Governance / Procurement.
* Ensure ongoing run\-cost and support\-cost implications are visible before go\-live.

title: Head of Growth
description:
**Associate Director\- Growth** 




 Location: Pune, India (on\-site)
 



 Experience: 6\+ years
 



  





**About the Company** 




 The client is is an AI\-first commercial management company for hotels and hotel operators in the US. They help clients grow revenue through a unified, tech\-led solution and service. They are a rapidly growing startup, 230\+ members strong, funded by top investors, and already profitable with several million USD in revenue.

 In this role you will own the entire revenue pipeline — from generating new hotel client leads across all channels to retaining and expanding our existing client base. You will also lead the lead generation and customer success teams. This is a high ownership, senior role.
 



  





**KRAs** 



* Lead Generation \- Own and optimize lead generation across email campaigns, Meta ads, cold calling, and expansion and referrals from the existing client base.
* Customer Retention \& Expansion \- Lead the CSM team to ensure every client gets consistent value and concerns are addressed before they escalate.
* Team Leadership \- Set clear goals, run regular reviews, and build a culture of ownership and continuous improvement.
* Strategy and Execution \- Use data across the funnel to identify opportunities and drive decisions — on lead quality, conversion, retention, and expansion.
* Cross Functional Collaboration \- Partner with product and tech teams on tools and automation that can improve the growth engine.



  





**Requirements** 



* Strong track record in multi\-channel outbound — email, ads, cold calling — and building lead generation engines from the ground up.
* You understand B2B subscription metrics: MRR, churn, NRR, LTV, CAC. You know how to use these to make decisions, not just report them.
* You are comfortable leading teams across different functions and holding them to outcomes.
* You thrive in fast\-moving environments and take ownership without waiting to be directed.
* Prior experience building and executing GTM strategies for the US market is a strong advantage.

title: Distribution Executive - US Hotels
description:
**Location:** 
 Pune, Yerwada (work from office)
 



**Shift:** 
 5 PM – 3 AM IST (Monday to Friday)
 



**CTC:** 
 4\-6 LPA
 



  





**About Atica** 




 Atica is a tech\-first sales and revenue partner for hotels across the United States. We build the technology and run the commercial operation that grows revenue for 200\+ properties — sales, revenue management, distribution and digital — from independents to hotels operating under Marriott, IHG, Hyatt, Choice and Wyndham.
 



  





**Find out more:** 




 https://www.aticaglobal.com https://www.linkedin.com/company/atica\-global
 



  





**The Opportunity** 




 Distribution is how Atica's hotels reach global B2B demand — through wholesalers and bed banks (Hotelbeds, WebBeds, Roibos, World2Meet, Travel Funders Network), travel management platforms (Engine, Bnberry) and redistribution partners (Nuitee).
 



  





 We are appointing a Manager to own that function end to end: the partner relationships, the commercial terms behind them, the channel and rate strategy across the portfolio, and the team that runs it.
 



  





 The mandate is to grow distribution's contribution to revenue, open the channels worth opening, close the ones that are not, and build the team and process behind it.
 



  





**What You Will Do** 



* Partner strategy and commercial ownership
* Own every demand partner relationship and the commercial terms behind it: performance reviews, negotiation, escalation, and keeping Atica's hotels prioritised on their platforms.
* Segment the partner portfolio by fit and contribution, and decide where to invest and where to withdraw.
* Open new channels end to end evaluate the opportunity, negotiate terms, contract, and see the first properties live and producing.
* Grow partner penetration and revenue contribution across every active channel.



  





**Channel and rate strategy** 




  




* Decide the channel mix by property and market, and set rate positioning and allotment alongside Revenue Management, who own final pricing.
* Manage redistribution and leakage risk to protect rate integrity across the portfolio.
* Audit content, pricing and offers for accuracy and commercial compliance.



  





**Building the function** 




  




* Hire, develop and lead the Distribution team.
* Turn recurring problems into a standard process, and decide what gets automated.
* Work with Product and Tech on what gets built — workflow gaps, feature requests and internal tooling.



  





**Across the business** 




  




* Partner with Sales and Revenue Management on hotel\-level commercial objectives.
* Engage US hotel stakeholders, Directors of Sales, Revenue Managers directly.



  





**How You'll Be Measured** 



* Revenue contribution from distribution.
* Partner penetration across active channels.
* Strength of the partner ecosystem, including how quickly escalations are resolved.
* Percentage of hotels live on channel within SLA.
* The team's performance and delivery quality.



  





 In your first quarter you will have met every partner, formed a view on which relationships are underperforming, and made the case for where we invest. Within the year, distribution contributes materially more revenue, the channel mix reflects a deliberate strategy, and the team is one you have built.
 



  





**What You Bring** 



* 1\-3 years in hotel distribution, contracting, wholesale, global sales, or a comparable commercial role in hospitality or travel.
* Working knowledge of the wholesale channel: contracting, allotments, rate fencing, markup chains and redistribution. From either side of the table if you have contracted hotels for a bed bank, that translates directly.
* A negotiation track record. You have owned commercial conversations with partners and moved the terms.
* Clear, structured stakeholder communication, and the ability to push back when it matters.
* Evidence of building process operational complexity turned into something documented and repeatable.
* Ownership of an outcome rather than a workflow.



  





**Bonus Points** 



* People management experience.
* TMC or B2B2C channel exposure.
* Familiarity with the US hotel market.
* Please Note Before Applying

title: Call Center Manager
company: Cholamandalam Investment and Finance Company Limited
description:
**Company Description** 
 Cholamandalam Investment and Finance Company Limited (Chola), part of the Murugappa Group and founded in 1978, has grown from an equipment financing firm into a leading comprehensive financial services provider. The company offers diverse products including vehicle finance, home loans, SME loans, home equity loans, loans against property, and consumer durable loans. With over 1,500 branches across India, AUM of more than Rs. 1\.77 lakh crore, and a customer base exceeding 4\.29 million, Chola provides strong national reach and scale. Its subsidiaries, including Cholamandalam Securities Limited, Cholamandalam Home Finance Limited, and Payswiff Technologies Private Limited, further strengthen its portfolio. Guided by integrity and responsibility, Chola focuses on sustainable growth and empowerment for customers, employees, shareholders, and communities.
 



**Role Description** 
 This is a full\-time, on\-site Call Center Manager role based in the Pune Division. The Call Center Manager will oversee day\-to\-day operations of the call center, including workforce planning, shift scheduling, and performance monitoring to ensure service levels are met. Responsibilities include managing and coaching a team of agents, conducting regular reviews, providing feedback, and organizing training to enhance customer service quality. The role involves analyzing call center metrics and customer feedback, implementing process improvements, and coordinating with internal stakeholders to resolve escalations and operational issues. The Call Center Manager will also ensure compliance with company policies and regulatory guidelines, promote a customer\-centric culture, and contribute to initiatives that drive customer satisfaction and operational efficiency.
 



**Qualifications** 







* Candidates should possess strong Contact Center Management and Team Management skills, with experience leading customer service or call center operations.
* Candidates should possess solid Customer Satisfaction skills, including the ability to design and implement initiatives that improve service quality and customer experience.
* Candidates should possess excellent Communication skills, with the ability to interact clearly and professionally with customers, team members, and leadership.
* Candidates should possess strong Analytical Skills to interpret call center metrics, identify trends, and recommend data\-driven process improvements.
* Relevant experience in financial services or BFSI sector is beneficial, especially in managing high\-volume customer interactions.

 Pune

 The Inside Sales Leader is responsible for leading a team of Inside Sales Associates (ISAMs) to drive account growth, manage customer relationships, and ensure efficient sales pipeline management. The Team Leader will collaborate with branches, field representatives, and internal teams to align sales strategies, drive sales campaigns, and improve overall team performance. **Roles And Responsibilities**

 oLead, mentor, and develop a team of Inside Sales Associates, ensuring they meet sales targets, maintain strong customer relationships, and adhere to company standards.
   

  

 oSet clear expectations for team performance, implementing corrective actions and training initiatives to drive both individual and team success.
   

  

 oFoster a collaborative and high\-performing culture, providing regular feedback, coaching, and mentoring.

Provide insights into how the products/services can meet specific customer needs and solve challenges. Collaborate with technical teams for product demonstrations, customized solutions, and resolving complex customer queries.

* Strong technical sales skills and understanding of the products/services being sold.
* High integrity, strong work ethic, and results\-driven approach.

 SKF's solutions provide sustainable ways for companies across the automotive and industrial sectors to achieve breakthroughs in friction reduction, energy efficiency, and equipment longevity and reliability.  The industrial market in India is a dynamic and rapidly evolving sector that plays a crucial role in a company’s economic growth, with the manufacturing sector being the most diverse and promising.  You will lead and support SAP\-enabled tax transformation efforts for US\-based clients, helping organizations improve the way tax integrates with enterprise processes and technology. You will work with client stakeholders, lead teams, and help deliver implementation\-driven solutions in a complex global tax environment.
   

  

**Work you'll do**
 As a Manager, Tax Services on the Tax Transformation Consulting (TTC) team, you will be responsible for:
   

  

* Business Development: Develop and maintain contact with top decision makers at key clients; organize and lead pursuit teams; participate and lead aspects of the proposal development process; contribute to the development of proposal pricing strategies.
* Client Management: Manage the day\-to\-day interactions with executive clients and sponsors.

**The team**
 Deloitte’s Tax Transformation Consulting (TTC) group helps our clients’ tax departments improve their operations by developing new technology\-enabled, cutting\-edge methods and processes. Deloitte TTC professionals are aligned across our global network of member firms to address our clients’ objectives in a seamless fashion. Deloitte TTC teams include industry, tax, organizational change, technology, and co\-sourcing specialists who help connect our clients’ global strategies and the options that exist to turn theory into an executable plan.
   

  

 TTC’s Enterprise Tax Integration (ETI) professionals provide an integrated approach to process improvement that can help the tax department maximize its strategic value to the organization. Companies that have already implemented or are considering implementing an enterprise resource planning (ERP) system often overlook the tax benefits these systems can provide or underestimate the impact on the tax department. To be most effective from a tax perspective, a successful ERP implementation requires professionals who specialize in tax and can effectively address a corporate tax function’s unique needs, requirements, and obligations. Our ETI team, the largest of its type, offers the necessary combination of skills, methodology and practical experience to help clients avoid the pitfalls of an ERP implementation.
   

  

 Tax Transformation Consulting (TTC) \- Ever expanding regulations and increasing scrutiny on multinational corporations has made it necessary for leading\-edge tax departments to serve a critical role in the risk management and overall performance of the enterprise. This has resulted in an opportunity for Deloitte to provide even greater value through our tax services, in helping develop tax departments of the future that are strategic, agile, and, above all, focused on creating value for the business.
   

  

 Deloitte's TTC group helps our clients’ tax department move forward from their current state to the next generation of tax functions and is dedicated to finding new methods and processes to assist clients in improving their tax operations. Deloitte Tax LLP professionals are aligned worldwide to serve our clients’ needs through the TTC group. Deloitte TTC teams include industry, tax, organizational change, technology, and co\-sourcing specialists who can help make the necessary connections between our clients’ global strategies and the many options for carrying them out in the tax function.
   

  

**Location: Bengaluru, Chennai, Gurugram, Hyderabad, Kolkata, Mumbai, Pune**

 Required:
   

  

* 8 to 15\+ years of total experience.
* 5\+ years of Implementation experience in SAP ECC 6\.0 \& S4 HANA with focus on Tax integration with SAP FICO/MM/SD integration with direct or indirect tax experience.
* Experience with tax technology applications i.e., ONESOURCE /Global NEXT Integration, Vertex/Accelerator \& Chain flow Accelerator Integration, Avalara, Sovos.
* Expert in Direct and Indirect Tax configuration, Withholding Taxes, local country indirect tax localizations, VAT customizations and Reporting.
* Experience with User Exits, preparing functional specifications, executing test cycles, cutovers, go\-live and Hypercare, providing user training and documentation.
* Expert in cross functional integration of modules \- SD\-FI \& MM\-FI
* Strong analytical skills in business process design and requirements preparation


 Preferred:
   

  

* SAP MM or SD (ECC or S4 HANA) Certified
* SAP DRC, Central Finance with Tax integration, Transfer Pricing, BRIM
* Experience with New GL, Accounts Receivable, Accounts Payable, Intercompany, Materials Management, Logistics Invoice Verification, Asset Accounting implementation.

description:
**Job Description** 




**Ciklum** 
 is looking for an
 **Associate Director Domain Consulting** 
 to join our team full\-time in India.
 



 We are a custom product engineering company that supports both multinational organizations and scaling startups to solve their most complex business challenges. With a global team of over 4,000 highly skilled developers, consultants, analysts and product owners, we engineer technology that redefines industries and shapes the way people live.
 



**About The Role** 




 We are seeking a seasoned, high\-impact an Associate Director Domain Consulting to anchor and scale our Retail \& Consumer Goods (RCG) vertical. With 12–15 years of industry expertise, you will act as the core consultative bridge between our global clients business challenges and our advanced IT and Digital Engineering services. In this role, your primary responsibility will be up\-front business consulting, proactive discovery, and strategic advisory. You will lead high\-value presales engagements, shape proactive transformational pitches, and author industry\-specific solutions across Digital Experience, Merchandising, and E\-commerce ecosystems. You will partner closely with Regional Sales Leaders and Technical Solution Architects to accelerate pipeline conversion and position our firm as an elite digital transformation partner.
 



**Responsibilities** 



1. **Domain Consulting \& Advisory (50%)**


* Subject Matter Expertise: Serve as the global designated authority on modern RCG workflows, driving the foundational business strategy across:



 Digital Experience: Personalization engines, loyalty frameworks, omnichannel customer journeys, and next\-generation smart\-store tech
 



 Merchandising: Inventory optimization, automated assortment planning, dynamic pricing strategies, and end\-to\-end supply chain visibility
 



 E\-commerce Ecosystems: Modern headless/composable commerce architecture, global marketplace integrations, and frictionless checkout optimization
 


* Discovery Workshops: Architect and lead consultative discovery sessions with enterprise\-tier prospective clients to unearth hidden operational pain points and map out actionable digital transformation roadmaps
* Strategic Client Advisory: Act as a trusted advisor to prospective client executives, bridging the gap between their business pain points and our technical delivery capabilities long before an RFP is issued



**Presales, Bid Advisory \& Solutioning (35%)** 



* Own the Domain Story: Author end\-to\-end functional and business solutions for complex RFPs, RFIs, and high\-value proactive pitches within the RCG space

* Defense \& Presentation: Lead orals and solution defense sessions with global prospect stakeholders (C\-level, VPs, Directors) to instill absolute confidence in our vertical capability



**Collateral \& Capability Building (15%)** 



* IP Development: Author forward\-looking white papers, case studies, point\-of\-view (POV) documents, and reusable retail\-specific capability frameworks
* Market Intelligence: Collaborate with the Enablement/Research team to analyze global retail trends, tech disruptions, and competitive landscapes to continuously optimize our market messaging
* Sample KRAs: Deal Win Ratio \& Conversion, Revenue Generation \& Pipeline Influence, Consulting Billability \& Utilization, Thought Leadership \& IP Creation, Solution Quality \& Stakeholder CSAT



**Requirements** 



* Overall Experience: 12–15 years of professional IT/Digital Services experience, with a minimum of 10\+ years dedicated strictly to Domain Consulting, Pre\-sales, \& Solutioning within the RCG domain
* Services Portfolio: Proven track record of winning large\-scale deals in Digital Engineering, Custom Application Development, Cloud Migrations, and Data/Analytics environments
* Domain Track Record: Demonstrable portfolio of shaping solutions across E\-commerce platforms (e.g., Salesforce Commerce Cloud, Adobe/Magento, Commercetools, or custom MACH setups), Unified Merchandising systems, and Digital CX platforms
* Core Competencies:
* Consultative Selling: Ability to pivot fluidly from a high\-level business strategy conversation with a retail Chief Marketing/Operating Officer to a technical alignment discussion with a Chief Architect
* Communication \& Presence: Exceptional verbal, written, and narrative storytelling skills. Ability to write clear, compelling proposal responses that avoid technical jargon where appropriate
* Collaborative Mindset: Experience working in a global matrixed environment, seamlessly orchestrating inputs from localized sales reps, technical leads, and shared enablement utilities
* Education:
* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field
* An MBA or equivalent post\-graduate management degree from a tier\-1 institute is highly preferred



**What’s in it for you?** 



* Strong community: Work alongside top professionals in a friendly, open\-door environment
* Growth focus: Take on large\-scale projects with a global impact and expand your expertise
* Tailored learning: Boost your skills with internal events (meetups, conferences, workshops), Udemy access, language courses, and company\-paid certifications
* Endless opportunities: Explore diverse domains through internal mobility, finding the best fit to gain hands\-on experience with cutting\-edge technologies
* Care: We’ve got you covered with company\-paid medical insurance, mental health support, and financial \& legal consultations



**About Us** 




 At Ciklum, we are always exploring innovations, empowering each other to achieve more, and engineering solutions that matter. With us, you’ll work with cutting\-edge technologies, contribute to impactful projects, and be part of a One Team culture that values collaboration and progress.
 



 India is a strategic innovation hub for Ciklum, with growing teams in Chennai and Pune leading advancements in EdgeTech, AR/VR, IoT, and beyond. Join us to collaborate on game\-changing solutions and take your career to the next level.
 



**Explore, empower, engineer with Ciklum!** 




 Interested already? We would love to get to know you! Submit your application. We can’t wait to see you at Ciklum.

 Experience

 Job Category

 Salesforce is the \#1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.
   

  

 Ready to level\-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

These technologies include\-\-but are not necessarily limited to Salesforce.com products and APIs, Apex/Visualforce, Lightning, mobile development technologies, and integration/ETL technologies.

title: Manager, Transaction Services
description:
**Our Purpose**
*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200\+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*
****Title And Summary****
 Manager, Transaction Services
   

  

 Who is Mastercard?
   

  

 Mastercard is a global technology company in the payments industry. Our mission is to connect and power an inclusive, digital economy that benefits everyone, everywhere by making transactions safe, simple, smart, and accessible. Using secure data and networks, partnerships and passion, our innovations and solutions help individuals, financial institutions, governments, and businesses realize their greatest potential.
   

  

 Our decency quotient, or DQ, drives our culture and everything we do inside and outside of our company. With connections across more than 210 countries and territories, we are building a sustainable world that unlocks priceless possibilities for all.
   

  

**Overview**
 The Global Business Service Center (GBSC) is looking for a Manager for their Transaction Services team to deliver end\-to\-end support across the Procure\-to\-Pay lifecycle and oversee corporate card administration programs, including Travel \& Entertainment (T\&E), Purchasing Cards (P\-Cards), and B2B payment solutions. The ideal candidate is passionate about the customer experience journey, highly motivated, intellectually curious, and a natural problem solver.
   

  

 Role
   

  

**In This Position, You Will:**
* Administer and support Mastercard's corporate card programs, including Travel \& Entertainment (T\&E), Purchasing Card (P\-Card), and B2B payment solutions, ensuring compliance with company policies and driving an optimal cardholder experience.
* Partner with cardholders, managers, banks, and internal stakeholders to resolve card program inquiries, support audits, manage exceptions, and identify opportunities to increase card adoption and program effectiveness.
* Ensure new suppliers are onboarded efficiently and timely with proper due diligence and risk assessments completed.
* Monitor PO spend and proactively submit requests to add funds to POs as needed.
* Provide advice on payment options, ensuring policy is followed for supplier engagements and charitable organizations (501(c)(3\)).
* Resolve and escalate issues in a timely fashion, providing updates to the customer.
* Provide insights on activity and recommendations on process improvements that will reduce friction and improve timeliness.
* Plan and organize work so that Service Level Agreement objectives are met or exceeded.


**All About You**
 The ideal candidate for this position should:
   

  

* Possess a deep understanding of the Procure\-to\-Pay lifecycle and supplier management processes.
* Have experience administering corporate card programs, including Travel \& Entertainment (T\&E), Purchasing Cards (P\-Cards), and B2B payment solutions, with a strong understanding of card controls, policy compliance, expense management, and payment optimization strategies.
* Have excellent customer service skills, understand the customer journey, and advocate for process improvements that benefit both customers and operational teams.
* Work effectively across functions to drive resolution, maintain customer satisfaction, and identify opportunities for continuous improvement. You turn problems into opportunities.
* Be skilled at explaining technical and process\-related issues succinctly and clearly.
* Have experience with ERP and expense management platforms such as Coupa, Oracle (R12/Fusion), Concur, or similar systems (preferred).
* Demonstrate strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with the ability to identify trends, manage risk, and provide actionable recommendations to stakeholders.
* Be highly organized, self\-motivated, and able to manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced environment.


 Corporate Security Responsibility
   

  

 Every Person Working For, Or On Behalf Of, Mastercard Is Responsible For Information Security. All Activities Involving Access To Mastercard Assets, Information, And Networks Comes With An Inherent Risk To The Organization And Therefore, It Is Expected That The Successful Candidate For This Position Must:
   

  

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

 All Activities Involving Access To Mastercard Assets, Information, And Networks Comes With An Inherent Risk To The Organization And, Therefore, It Is Expected That Every Person Working For, Or On Behalf Of, Mastercard Is Responsible For Information Security And Must:

 .

 .

 ZOOP Analytics' portfolio includes

title: Staff Technical Account Manager
description:
What You'll Do
   

  

 The Staff Technical Account Manager is responsible is a critical member of Avalara’s support organization, responsible for managing technical tickets, ensuring timely resolution, and driving customer satisfaction for our Enterprise. Involving complex product and connector issues that cannot be fully resolved through frontline troubleshooting alone, while improving the speed, quality, and consistency of engineering engagement. This is an engineering\-aligned support talent that can reduce time to resolution, improve case quality, raise the standard of Jira submissions, and turn repeat issues into durable knowledge and process improvements. It also reflects Avalara’s broader need to embed AI into technical support in practical ways that improve investigation speed, communication quality, and team scalability. In addition to resolving complex issues, this role is expected to use AI in day\-to\-day work to accelerate research, strengthen technical analysis, improve case documentation, and identify opportunities to make technical support more effective and scalable over time.
   

  

 The business outcome this role enables is straightforward: better customer experience, faster and more reliable resolution of complex cases, better use of engineering capacity, stronger support scalability, and fewer repeat incidents over time. By combining technical judgment with thoughtful AI adoption, this role also helps Avalara improve how support work is performed, not just how individual cases are resolved.
   

  

**How This Role Elevates Avalara**
* This role raises the technical bar of Enterprise Support by bringing stronger investigation discipline, better case documentation, cleaner handoffs, more effective Jira creation, and clearer collaboration with Product and Engineering. It also improves the capability of the broader support organization by turning difficult cases into reusable knowledge, troubleshooting actions, and support\-ready guidance that reduces future rework.
* This role helps Avalara reduce unnecessary Jira volume, improve the quality of engineering escalations, and protect engineering capacity for the issues that truly require development effort. It also supports better operational performance through stronger SLA discipline, cleaner milestone adherence, faster TTR, and more predictable case outcomes.
* This role improves customer trust by ensuring that the most complex issues are handled with technical depth, clear communication, accurate diagnosis, and accountable resolution ownership. It also improves the long\-term customer experience by reducing repeat incidents and strengthening self\-service through better knowledge assets and preventative actions.
* Protect and increase Enterprise customer revenue and retention by resolving complex customer\-impacting issues quickly and accurately.
* For customers, the TAM provides a trusted technical partner who understands their environment, anticipates risk, and delivers clarity during high\-impact situations. This proactive, relationship\-driven approach increases platform reliability, improves customer experience, and drives long\-term success


**What Your Responsibilities Will Be**
* Provide leadership and mentorship to TAMs – providing knowledge sessions, brown\-bag training and advanced troubleshooting of APIs and ERPs.
* Own a portfolio of Avalara’s Enterprise customers with premium support entitlement.
* Own complex support cases from assignment through verified resolution, especially where advanced troubleshooting, reproduction, deep product analysis, or engineering coordination is required.
* Perform advanced troubleshooting and root cause analysis across ERP/CRM/eCommerce platforms (NetSuite, D365, SAP, Oracle, Salesforce, Shopify, Workday, etc.).
* Diagnose customer issues across AvaTax, connectors, and related workflows by reproducing issues, gathering diagnostics, isolating scope, documenting findings, and confirming business impact.
* Determine when engineering involvement is warranted and ensure Jira tickets are necessary, complete, technically credible, and supported by strong due diligence before submission.
* Create, refine, and manage Jira tickets that clearly describe the issue, expected and actual behaviour, troubleshooting completed, reproduction detail, supporting evidence, and urgency.
* Partner closely with Product and Engineering to drive defect resolution, maintain momentum on linked development work, and keep customer cases moving while internal work is in progress.
* Maintain strong customer communication discipline by meeting milestone expectations, providing proactive updates, responding quickly to new customer messages, and keeping status and documentation audit ready.
* Improve support effectiveness beyond the individual case by completing troubleshooting of the issues and analysis on major or repeat issues and contributing knowledge articles, playbooks, or reusable troubleshooting guidance that reduce repeat volume.
* Contribute to High priority support or production\-support responsiveness where applicable by providing fast technical guidance, validating escalation paths, and helping the broader support organization make better decisions earlier in the case lifecycle.
* Act as a technical role model for quality, ownership, and judgment in how cases are investigated, escalated, documented, and resolved.
* Contribute to responsible AI adoption by using sound judgment, validating outputs, and ensuring that final recommendations, communications, and actions remain accurate and customer ready.
* Help embed AI into support ways of working by sharing effective use cases, improving repeatable practices, and supporting continuous improvement across the team.


**12\-Month Success Signals**
* Consistently meets or exceeds SLA targets and maintains high CSAT scores.
* Reduces complex escalation backlog and improves average resolution time.
* Contributes documented root\-cause fixes that decrease repeat incidents.
* Delivers measurable efficiency gains through AI\-assisted workflows (e.g., reduced case handling time, improved documentation speed).


 What You’ll Need To Be Successful
   

  

**At Avalara, this role is expected to be a bar raiser for Support Engineering, leveraging technical expertise, data\-driven insights, and AI\-enabled capabilities to elevate troubleshooting, accelerate issue resolution, and prevent recurring customer problems. They continuously improve support operations, knowledge management, and team effectiveness while delivering exceptional customer outcomes.**
* Raise the bar for the team. Provide guidance, improve execution quality, and leave cases, routing, and knowledge resources better than you found them.
* Own complex cases end to end. Drive the issue forward, clarify ambiguity, follow up proactively, and make sure cases do not stall waiting on others.
* Identify and drove resolution of recurring product defects, resulting in improved customer experience and reduced support volume.
* Consistently achieve high customer satisfaction scores through effective issue ownership, technical expertise, and proactive communication.
* Reduce critical issue resolution time to 5 days through structured root cause analysis and cross\-functional collaboration.


**AI Bar Raiser Expectations**
**This role is expected to be an AI Bar Raiser, applying AI in a deliberate and impactful way to improve how technical issues are diagnosed, resolved, and prevented, while elevating the team’s ability to use AI to drive meaningful gains in support efficiency, knowledge quality, technical troubleshooting, and customer outcomes.**
* Leverage AI\-powered tools to accelerate root cause analysis and reduce troubleshooting time for complex customer issues.
* Identify and implement new AI\-driven approaches to technical support (e.g., automated diagnostics, intelligent case triage, predictive risk identification) that go beyond current team practices
* Utilize Generative AI to create knowledge base articles, troubleshooting guides, and customer\-facing documentation, improving knowledge accessibility and consistency
* Develop AI\-driven workflows that automated repetitive support tasks, increasing team productivity and reducing manual effort.
* Create AI\-powered prompt libraries and support playbooks that standardized troubleshooting approaches across the team.
* Collaborate with Product and Engineering teams to integrate AI\-driven customer feedback analysis into product improvement initiatives.
* Champion AI adoption across the support organization, driving measurable improvements in resolution efficiency and support quality.
* Use AI insights to prioritize critical customer issues based on business impact, severity, and historical trends.


**Qualifications A**
* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, IT, Engineering, or a related field.
* 5\+ years of proven experience in handling complex technical issues in SaaS, APIs, integrations, or similar environments, with strong troubleshooting and root cause analysis skills.
* Expert experience with ERP/CRM/eCommerce platforms: NetSuite, Microsoft Dynamics, SAP S/4 Hana, SageX, Salesforce, Magento, Oracle, Shopify, Workday, or similar systems is required
* Demonstrated proficiency in API and workflow analysis across ERP, e\-Commerce, and Marketplace platforms.
* Demonstrated ability to collaborate with Engineering/Product teams and manage high\-quality escalation artifacts (e.g., Jira) with clear technical detail.
* Strong communication skills with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Experience working in SLA\-driven support environments using tools such as Salesforce, Jira, and Confluence.
* Mandatory experience using AI tools and automation to improve support efficiency, diagnostics, communication quality, and scalability.


 Avalara is an AI\-first Company
   

  

 AI is embedded in our workflows, decision\-making, and products. Success here requires embracing AI as an essential capability.
   

  

* You’ll bring experience using AI and AI\-related technologies, ready to thrive here.
* You’ll apply AI every day to business challenges \- improving efficiency, contributing solutions, and driving results for your team, our company, and our customers.
* You’ll grow with AI by staying curious about new trends and best practices, and by sharing what you learn so others can benefit too.


 How We’ll Take Care Of You
   

  

 Total Rewards
   

  

 In addition to a great compensation package, paid time off, and paid parental leave, many Avalara employees are eligible for bonuses.
   

  

 Health \& Wellness
   

  

 Benefits vary by location but generally include private medical, life, and disability insurance.
   

  

 Inclusive culture and diversity
   

  

 Avalara strongly supports diversity, equity, and inclusion, and is committed to integrating them into our business practices and our organizational culture. We also have a total of 8 employee\-run resource groups, each with senior leadership and exec sponsorship.
   

  

**What You Need To Know About Avalara**
 We’re defining the relationship between tax and tech.
   

  

 We’ve already built an industry\-leading cloud compliance platform, processing over 54 billion customer API calls and over 6\.6 million tax returns a year. Our growth is real \- we're a billion dollar business \- and we’re not slowing down until we’ve achieved our mission \- to be part of every transaction in the world.
   

  

 We’re bright, innovative, and disruptive, like the orange we love to wear. It captures our quirky spirit and optimistic mindset. It shows off the culture we’ve designed, that empowers our people to win. We’ve been different from day one. Join us, and your career will be too.
   

  

**We’re An Equal Opportunity Employer**
 Supporting diversity and inclusion is a cornerstone of our company — we don’t want people to fit into our culture, but to enrich it. All qualified candidates will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, creed, religion, age, gender, national orientation, disability, sexual orientation, US Veteran status, or any other factor protected by law. If you require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, please let us know.

title: CCS Consultant / Implementation Officer (Client Conversion & Implementation)
description:
**Position Details** 



* **Role:** 
 CCS Consultant / Implementation Officer (Client Conversion \& Implementation)
* **Location:** 
 Ghansoli, Navi Mumbai (3 days a week onsite and 2 days remote)
* **Shift:** 
 Rotational Shifts
* **Experience Required:** 
 7\+ Years of Core Financial Services Experience
* **Domain Focus:** 
 Custody Operations, Back\-Office Investment Accounting, Global Client Implementation, Transaction Management
* **Key Platforms:** 
 MCH, Advent Geneva, eHorizon, or equivalent accounting/custody engines
* **Notice Period:** 
 Immediate to 30 Days Preferred



**Position Overview** 




 In this leadership role, you will take ownership of client conversion initiatives, onboarding plans, and operational deliverables for premier institutional accounting, custody, and insurance clients. Acting as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) and project lead, you will bridge the gap between global clients, internal Centers of Excellence (COEs), and daily operations teams. You will drive the seamless migration of historical data, configure operating models, standardize accounting methodologies, oversee settlement/SWIFT workflows, and transition portfolios into business\-as\-usual (BAU) delivery mode.
 



**Key Responsibilities** 



* **Conversion \& Onboarding Leadership:** 
 Direct the planning and execution of onboarding roadmaps and conversion workstreams for custody, fund accounting, and insurance client portfolios.
* **Operating Model Alignment:** 
 Map operational workflows, identify and document processing methodology variances between legacy and target environments, and articulate these changes clearly to clients and internal stakeholders.
* **Accounting \& Custody Operations Oversight:** 
 Oversee complex custody workflows pre\- and post\-conversion, including trade capture, fails management, Standard Settlement Instructions (SSIs), corporate actions/asset servicing, cash allocations, and SWIFT message protocols (MT5xx / MT1xx / MT2xx).
* **Platform \& System Migration:** 
 Leverage deep functional expertise in platforms like
 **Geneva, MCH, and eHorizon** 
 to troubleshoot accounting exceptions, NAV discrepancies, and position breaks during parallel runs.
* **Process Optimization \& Governance:** 
 Assess operational efficiency, eliminate bottlenecks, design straight\-through processing improvements, and ensure strict compliance with risk\-mitigation controls.
* **Cross\-Functional \& COE Coordination:** 
 Partner with global Shared Services, COEs, Technology, and Client Service verticals to guarantee procedural accuracy and meet strict SLA deadlines.
* **Team Leadership \& Mentorship:** 
 Guide, train, and mentor conversion team members, conduct cross\-skilling sessions, oversee daily deliverables, and drive high performance across rotational shift windows.
* **Executive \& Risk Reporting:** 
 Track project milestones, maintain audit trails, and proactively escalate migration risks and timeline variances with proposed remediation strategies.



**Qualifications \& Sourcing Criteria** 




**Must\-Have:** 



* **Experience:** 
**10\+ years of active financial services experience** 
 specializing in Global Custody Operations, Fund Accounting Conversions, Investment Manager Servicing, or Back\-Office Transaction Management.
* **Education:** 
 Bachelor’s or Master’s degree with a concentration in Accounting, Finance, Economics, Commerce, or Financial Technology.
* **Custody \& Settlement Mechanics:** 
 Expert understanding of global custody frameworks, clearing/settlement cycles, asset servicing, SSIs, cash reconciliation, and SWIFT message structures.
* **Complex Fund Knowledge:** 
 Deep domain exposure to offshore products, ETFs, hedged structures, derivatives, and Master\-Feeder setups.
* **Platform Proficiency:** 
 Hands\-on operational knowledge of accounting engines such as
 **Advent Geneva, MCH, eHorizon** 
 , or comparable tier\-1 systems.
* **Leadership \& Influence:** 
 Proven track record of leading teams, managing complex stakeholder relationships, and driving client implementations independently.
* **Shift Flexibility:** 
 Willingness to work in
 **rotational shifts** 
 from the
 **Ghansoli, Navi Mumbai** 
 office.



**Preferred / Desired:** 



* Industry\-recognized credentials such as Investment Banking Certifications, CFA, or CA/CPA.
* Demonstrated experience handling large\-scale fund migrations, ledger conversions, and parallel accounting runs.
* Outstanding analytical, negotiation, and executive communication skills.



**Why Join This Team?** 



* **Strategic Executive Visibility:** 
 Direct operational leadership over multi\-billion\-dollar global custody and accounting migrations.
* **Complex Asset Exposure:** 
 End\-to\-end engagement with sophisticated investment structures across international markets.
* **Dynamic Culture:** 
 Lead high\-performing teams within a collaborative, merit\-driven global client onboarding organization.



  





 If you are a seasoned financial operations and conversion leader ready to take on this Officer\-level position in Navi Mumbai, please reply with your updated resume, current location, current fixed CTC, expected CTC, and official notice period / last working date.

title: Partnerships Manager
description:
**About Virohan:** 




 Founded in 2018, by Kunaal Dudeja, Nalin Saluja and Archit Jayaswal, Virohan is an education\-to\-industry partner, shaping the future of healthcare education. It enables India's top universities to deliver best\-in\-class undergraduate programs such as Optometry, MLT, Hospital Administration, OTT, MRIT, and more. Combining cutting\-edge technology, learner\-centric innovations, and strong industry partnerships, Virohan equips students with skills that go beyond degrees, preparing them
 



 for meaningful careers in healthcare. By 2030, Virohan aims to impact a million aspiring healthcare professionals and collaborate with over 100 universities across India to transform education and strengthen healthcare.
 



 We are backed by Blume Ventures, Mynavi Corporation and Rebright Partners (Japan), Elea Foundation and Artha Impact (Switzerland), Yunus Social Business (Germany), AngelList, and Keiretsu Forum, among others. Virohan operates at the intersection of education and Healthcare—two industries that have entered a new phase of rapid growth post\-pandemic. The time to make your mark in this space is now! We’re looking for entrepreneurs to join us in building the next unicorn.
 



  





**Role Overview:** 




 We are looking for a
 **Manager/Senior Manager – Partnerships \& Alliances** 
 to lead strategic collaborations with top private universities across India.
 



 This is a senior, high\-impact role where you will engage directly with university leadership — Chancellors, Vice Chancellors, Vice Presidents, Directors, and Deans — to forge long\-term, high\-value partnerships. You will be responsible for driving alliances that enable universities to launch and scale Allied Health Science programs through revenue\-sharing models, ensuring both academic excellence and sustainable business growth.
 



 The ideal candidate is a confident relationship builder, a strategic thinker, and a trusted advisor capable of influencing senior stakeholders and translating opportunities into impactful collaborations.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 




**A. Business Development \& Strategic Partnerships** 




 ● Identify and develop partnerships with top\-tier NAAC A, A\+, and A\+\+ private universities across India.
 



 ● Build and maintain a strong pipeline of potential partners and manage the end\-to\-end partnership lifecycle — from outreach and engagement to closure and onboarding.
 



 ● Establish deep, trust\-based relationships with senior university leaders and decision\-makers.
 



 ● Lead partnership discussions and negotiations to secure win\-win agreements aligned with Virohan’s growth goals.
 



**B. Sector \& Market Expertise** 




 ● Develop an in\-depth understanding of Allied Health Sciences and the higher education ecosystem to position yourself as a domain expert.
 



 ● Stay up to date with UGC guidelines, regulatory frameworks, and emerging trends in healthcare education.
 



 ● Monitor market movements and competitive landscape to identify new partnership opportunities and strategic directions.
 



**C. Cross\-Functional Collaboration** 




 ● Work closely with internal teams and partner universities to ensure seamless handover and successful program implementation.
 



 ● Collaborate with Partner Success and Academic teams to deliver exceptional outcomes for universities and students alike.
 



 ● Drive operational excellence and ensure partnerships deliver long\-term value.
 



  





**Experience \& Skills Requirements:** 




 ●
 **3\+ years of experience in B2B sales, strategic partnerships, or account management, preferably engaging with universities or large institutions.** 




 ● Proven success in managing C\-suite or senior academic relationships and closing large, consultative deals.
 



 ● Strong existing network within the higher education ecosystem is highly desirable.
 



 ● Exceptional communication, negotiation, and interpersonal abilities.
 



 ● Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and stakeholder management skills.
 



 ● Self\-driven, goal\-oriented, and capable of working independently while collaborating cross functionally.
 



  





**Why Join Us** 




 At Virohan, you’ll play a pivotal role in transforming India’s healthcare education landscape. You’ll work with passionate teams, visionary leaders, and a mission\-driven culture that rewards innovation, ownership, and real\-world impact.
